subject: HL integration: enablement & go-live coordination
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia@healthlink.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HL integration: enablement & go-live coordination

Hi Patricia —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to start the thread that will carry our implementation runbook and handoff artifacts. The goal on our side is to line up a 3‑week enablement window focused on three items: streaming output, tool/function calling integration, and structured JSON outputs (schema validation + examples).

Quick agenda we propose for week 1–3:
- Week 1: Dev onboarding + schema alignment (sample payloads, example prompts)
- Week 2: Test harness + streaming + KV cache validation (latency checks)
- Week 3: Canary rollout, fallback routing, production runbook and go‑live cutover

Action items from you:
1) Confirm target go‑live week (proposed: week of 2028‑06‑12)
2) Provide dev sandbox access (URL + test creds) or contact who controls environment
3) Share any compliance artifacts we should review early (e.g., retention policy, SOC2 scope)

I've attached an initial checklist to this email to help structure the kickoff. Camila will follow up with the detailed implementation plan and milestone dates. Ben will coordinate scheduling and engineering availability.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Principal Customer Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: HL_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Patricia Gomez <patricia@healthlink.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HL integration: enablement & go-live coordination

Thanks Rafael — adding our implementation runway here so we have a single reference. Patricia, copying the milestones you can expect from Redwood: 

Implementation plan (high level):
- Day 0–3: Kickoff + access verification. We will validate streaming endpoints and confirm client request/response shapes.
- Day 4–10: Schema alignment and contract test creation. We will provide a JSON schema and sample generator; your engineering team will provide representative example prompts and expected structured outputs.
- Day 11–16: Integration + functional testing (tool calls) — we will exercise function calling with stubbed tool endpoints to validate edge cases and error handling.
- Day 17–21: Canary and rollback plan: short canary window, verify token-level cost/latency metrics, enable automatic fallback to smaller model variant during spike.

Deliverables: HL_impl_plan_v1.pdf (attached), sample JSON schema, and a test harness link. We recommend a single primary POC for schema decisions (to avoid drift).

Open questions for HealthLink (please reply inline):
- Do you have existing canonical schema owners?
- Are there rate limits we should be aware of on the sandbox?

I'll upload the implementation plan and schema to the shared Drive folder referenced below.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Implementation Lead, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: HL_impl_plan_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia@healthlink.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HL integration: enablement & go-live coordination

Hi all — scheduling note and a few technical asks.

1) Proposed 60‑minute kickoff blocks (pick one):
   - Tue 2028‑05‑23 09:00–10:00 PT
   - Wed 2028‑05‑24 13:00–14:00 PT
   - Thu 2028‑05‑25 11:00–12:00 PT

2) Technical prerequisites we need from HealthLink prior to kickoff:
   - Dev sandbox URL + an account with read/write access to exercise toolcalls
   - Example request/response pairs (for both streaming and non‑streaming flows)
   - One sample production JSON payload so we can generate the initial schema and tests
3) Compliance/artifact ask: If you can drop SOC2 scope page or the retention policy in the Drive folder we can begin our compliance read.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/HL-Implementation (I uploaded a stub of the test harness and the first draft sample generator). Also filed the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/HL-4721.

I'll wait on the sandbox credentials to spin up the test harness. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Patricia Gomez <patricia@healthlink.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir@healthlink.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HL integration: enablement & go-live coordination

Thanks team — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick responses: 

- Sandbox: I can provision a service account for you today; I'll send credentials via our SFTP/Secrets channel (we don't email API creds). Expect a separate message from Samir with the access window.
- Kickoff: Wed 2028‑05‑24 13:00 PT works for our engineers.
- Compliance: I'll upload the SOC2 scope and retention summary to the Drive by EOD.
- API keys / rotation: We require short‑lived keys for third‑party integrations and would like to confirm Redwood's key rotation guidance + support for customer‑managed KMS during production.

Quote: "On Fri, 18 May 2028 at 12:15 Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:"
> I'll wait on the sandbox credentials to spin up the test harness.

Will get back shortly with the SFTP details and Samir will be the technical POC for the sandbox.

—Patricia

Perfect — thank you, Patricia. Confirming the kickoff: Wed 2028‑05‑24 13:00 PT.

Next steps (consolidated):
- Samir: drop sandbox SFTP + provisioning window to the Drive link Ben shared.
- HealthLink: upload SOC2 scope + retention summary to Drive (EOD).
- Redwood: Camila will publish the JSON schema draft and test harness by Monday 2028‑05‑21. Ben will circulate the calendar invite and the kickoff agenda. I'll own the go‑live runbook and post‑launch rollback playbook; I'll attach the current runbook for reference.

Attachments included: redwood-implementation-handbook.pdf (internal runbook extract).

If anything changes on the schedule, please flag here — otherwise we'll treat this as confirmed. Looking forward to a smooth rollout.

Best,
